title: Brazil - Remote: Back-end Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a \"deliver fast\" mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Streaming & High-Throughput Data

  • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
  • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.

GenAI & Autonomous Agents

  • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
  • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers

Graph & Knowledge Engineering

  • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
  • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.


Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.
  • You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency.

Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

Location

Fully remote position.

Job Details

Requisition Number:

Experience Level: Mid to Senior

Job Family: Engineering/Science/Technology

Product Service Line: Landmark Software & Services

Full Time / Part Time: Full Time

Employee Group: Temporary

title: Backend Developer - Node.js
description:
Job Description


We are looking for a Back-end Developer to work on the development and evolution of back-end applications using Node.js and NestJS. The professional will be responsible for building scalable solutions, maintaining engineering best practices, contributing to technical decisions, and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a dynamic and agile environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain back-end applications using Node.js and NestJS .
  • Ensure clean, scalable, and well-documented code.


Data Management

  • Implement and manage relational databases (PostgreSQL ) and non-relational databases (MongoDB ).
  • Optimize queries and ensure data integrity.


Version Control

  • Use Git for version control, maintaining code history and integrity.
  • Collaborate through pull requests and code reviews.


Agile Methodologies

  • Actively participate in sprints , plannings, and other agile ceremonies.
  • Adapt quickly to changing requirements and priorities.


Quality & Automation

  • Write automated tests to guarantee quality and stability.
  • Use CI/CD tools to support continuous integration and delivery.


Communication & Teamwork

  • Collaborate with multifunctional teams (product, design, QA, front‑end).
  • Communicate requirements and delivery status clearly.


Nice-to-Have Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable microservices and RESTful APIs .
  • Configure and manage containers using Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Deploy and manage applications on cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud ).


Requirements


  • Proficiency in Node.js and NestJS .
  • Strong knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL ) and non-relational (MongoDB ) databases.
  • Experience with version control using Git .
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban ).
  • Ability to write clean, scalable, and well-structured code.
  • Experience with automated testing and CI/CD tools.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.


Differential Competencies

  • Experience with microservices architecture .
  • Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Experience with cloud services (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).

title: Estagio - Devops
description:
A DreamSquad é uma boutique especializada em Cloud Computing , atuando com clientes de diferentes segmentos e portes. Nossos projetos são focados em: Excelência operacional, Segurança e confiabilidade, Alta performance, Otimização de custos E Sustentabilidade.

Estamos em constante crescimento e nos tornando uma referência no setor, elevando o padrão de qualidade das entregas.

Buscamos uma pessoa em início de carreira em Cloud/DevOps que queira aprender na prática, atuar em projetos reais e se desenvolver em um ambiente colaborativo e técnico.


Principais atividades

Você irá atuar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento e DevOps para:

  • Automatizar processos e rotinas operacionais.
  • Configurar e manter pipelines de CI/CD .
  • Apoiar na identificação e resolução de problemas de infraestrutura em nuvem.
  • Criar e manter monitoramento da camada sistêmica dos clientes.
  • Contribuir com documentação técnica e aprender continuamente sobre boas práticas de engenharia.


Requisitos

  • Conhecimentos básicos em DevOps e AWS .
  • Vontade de aprender, se desenvolver e crescer na área de cloud.
  • Perfil colaborativo e interesse por automação e infraestrutura.


Diferenciais

  • Certificação AWS (mesmo que inicial).
  • Experiência acadêmica ou pessoal com:
  • Cloud
  • Infraestrutura
  • Containers
  • CI/CD
  • Monitoramento


O que a Dream oferece pra te apoiar nessa jornada?

Hub de incentivos no valor de R$ 30,00 reais por dia no cartão Ifood;

Recesso remunerado

Wellhub (Gympass)

Avus - Desconto em farmácia

Reembolso e bônus por certificação AWS

Auxilio Educação de R$ 1800, por ano

Clube Ifood com cupons de descontos

Starbem - Plataforma de saude e bem estar

Nav Dasa - pronto atendimento online com descontos em consultas e exames

Petlove

Parceria com a FIAP de até 20%

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
O iScholar é uma edtech brasileira com 20 anos de mercado especializada em softwares para instituições de ensino. Pertencemos ao ESDS Edtech Group, um grupo Íbero-latino-americano com presença em 8 países, focado em oferecer soluções tecnológicas para o mercado de educação.


Como Consultor Comercial / Closer no iScholar, sua missão será desenvolver novos negócios para a empresa.

Nós do iScholar lhe daremos todo o suporte e treinamento necessários, para que você tenha a oportunidade de se tornar um consultor comercial de alta performance. 


Você será responsável por:

  • Coletar requisitos e dores dos clientes em potencial
  • Realizar demonstrações de produto
  • Desenvolver negociações com potenciais clientes
  • Visitar potenciais cliente presencialmente na cidade base ou em rotas comerciais
  • Prospecção de novos clientes
  • Mapear concorrentes


Estamos procurando por uma pessoa que:

  • Seja comunicativo mas que seja também bom ouvinte
  • Tenha bom raciocínio lógico
  • Seja determinado
  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e com foco no cliente
  • Seja motivado a resultado, resiliente e alto nível de energia
  • Tenha domínio da língua portuguesa (oral e escrita)


Você precisa:

  • Ter facilidade com tecnologia
  • Ter boa oratória e facilidade com vendas consultivas
  • Domínio das ferramentas do Google e Linkedin
  • Inglês básico
  • Experiência anterior com vendas no segmento educacional e/ou em empresas de tecnologia
  • Experiência com CRM e conhecimento de funil de vendas
  • Ter disponibilidade para viagens


Será ótimo se você também tiver:

  • Conhecimento básico de marketing digital
  • Cursos e certificações em vendas e técnicas de vendas
  • Ser familiarizado com rotinas de uma instituição de ensino


O que vamos te oferecer:

  • Salário a combinar
  • Carga horária 40h/semanais, segunda à sexta-feira
  • Vale refeição
  • Seguro de vida
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico integrais
  • Ajuda de custo para trabalho em home office


Data de início prevista: 10/02/2026

title: Senior SAP Consultant
description:
Senior SAP Fieldglass Consultant (Remote, Brazil)


We are looking for a Senior SAP Fieldglass Consultant to join a global project, working 100 percent remotely from Brazil . This role is for someone with real hands on experience in SAP Fieldglass implementations , not generic SAP consulting.


If you have worked deeply with Fieldglass CWM and SOW , understand Source to Pay , and are comfortable working directly with clients, this role is for you.


What You Will Do

  • Work on SAP Fieldglass implementation and rollout projects
  • Configure and support Contingent Workforce Management (CWM) and Statement of Work (SOW) processes
  • Collaborate with procurement, HR, finance, and IT stakeholders
  • Support integrations between SAP Fieldglass and SAP Ariba, SAP S 4HANA, or SAP ECC
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into Fieldglass configuration
  • Identify risks early and propose clear mitigation actions
  • Support testing, defect resolution, and UAT activities using JIRA
  • Ensure high quality delivery with strong focus on customer satisfaction

Mandatory Experience

  • 6 or more years of hands on experience with SAP Fieldglass
  • Proven experience in Fieldglass implementation or rollout projects
  • Strong configuration experience in CWM and SOW
  • Solid understanding of Source to Pay processes
  • Experience integrating Fieldglass with SAP Ariba and SAP S 4HANA or SAP ECC
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working with stakeholders

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SAP SuccessFactors
  • Previous work in global or multi country projects
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills

Work Setup

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work model: 100 percent remote
  • Client interview required
  • English is mandatory for daily communication

Important

  • Resumes must be submitted in English
  • This role requires real SAP Fieldglass project experience
  • Candidates without Fieldglass hands on experience will not be considered

title: Senior Software (TypeScript/Ruby/React) Engineer
description:
Summary

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help shape and scale a modern web experience for a fast-paced, consumer-facing product team. You’ll work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver elegant, performant, and maintainable applications using TypeScript, Ruby on Rails and React . This role is ideal for someone who possesses a high level of agency, a \"doer\" mentality, and the ability to maintain a full product vision while shipping high-quality code at speed.


Core Requirements :

  • Mastery of TypeScript and React for building complex, scalable web applications.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in frontend development with a proven track record of shipping production-grade software.
  • Experience working with Ruby on Rails (or interest in a product where RoR is core)
  • Prior experience in the Trading, Brokerage, or Wealth Management industries.
  • Demonstrated high level of agency and a proactive \"doer\" mentality, with the ability to hit the ground running and own features end-to-end.
  • Strong product sense and the ability to build for the long term while balancing immediate delivery needs.
  • Excellent understanding of modern frontend architecture, state management, and performance optimization.
  • Solid experience with unit testing and a commitment to maintaining high code quality through thoughtful testing practices.
  • Comfort navigating fast-paced environments and collaborating within cross-functional agile teams.
  • Strong eye for design-to-dev fidelity and a passion for creating fluid, responsive user interfaces.


Nice to Have :

  • Full-stack development experience or a strong understanding of backend systems and API design.
  • Experience working with GraphQL APIs and modern data-fetching libraries.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows for web applications.
  • Exposure to modern CSS-in-JS libraries or advanced styling frameworks.


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community, fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career - we’re the destination.


The icing on the Kake:

Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: Entrepreneur and SMEs (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking to speak with entrepreneurs, founders, and executives of startups, scale-ups, and small to medium enterprises (10-50 employee).



Qualifications:

  • The purpose of this study is to gain an understanding of the global awareness of city’s attractiveness in trade, investment and partnership. I believe your opinions and expertise would be valuable for our study and I wonder if you’re interested in taking part.
  • Job titles: Founder, Co-founder, C-suite Executive, Partner, Director, Vice President, General Manager, Head of Department.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an informal 30-minute interview conducted via MS Teams and the interview can be held in either English or Portuguese.
  • Please note that, before the final interview, there'll be a 10-minute quick online screener to share more details on the research and to check that this is relevant to you.


Compensation package - BRL 945 for a 30-minute online interview.

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: Databricks Architect
description:
Databricks Architect / Senior Data Engineer (Contract)

Location: Brazil (Remote – supporting US-based clients)

Contract Length: 6 months


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Databricks Architect who remains highly hands-on as a Data Engineer to support data platform design and delivery for US-based clients. This role will focus on building and optimizing modern lakehouse solutions, with strong ownership of architecture decisions while actively contributing to development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and evolve Databricks lakehouse solutions , following medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) best practices
  • Act as the technical architect while remaining hands-on in pipeline development , optimization, and troubleshooting
  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines using Databricks, Spark, and SQL
  • Collaborate with US-based stakeholders, architects, and delivery teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Optimize performance, cost, and reliability across data workloads
  • Contribute to data modeling, data quality, and governance practices
  • Leverage recent exposure to Microsoft Fabric where appropriate, understanding how it complements or integrates with Databricks-based architectures


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience as a Databricks Architect and/or Senior Data Engineer
  • Proven, hands-on experience implementing medallion architecture in production environments
  • Advanced knowledge of Apache Spark , Databricks , and SQL
  • Experience designing end-to-end data pipelines and lakehouse architectures
  • Recent exposure to Microsoft Fabric (hands-on preferred)
  • Ability to balance architecture leadership with hands-on engineering work
  • Strong English language skills and experience working with US-based clients or teams


Nice to Have

  • Experience in consulting or professional services environments
  • Familiarity with data governance, security, and cost optimization in cloud platforms
  • Experience working in hybrid Databricks / Fabric ecosystems

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
About the Company

Ambush is a people first company where talented, thoughtful individuals come together to build meaningful products and lasting partnerships. We believe the best work happens when people feel supported, trusted and empowered to bring their full abilities to the table.

Since 2015, because of our people first and long term mindset, we have grown into a partner relied on by some of the best companies in the world. We combine strong engineering, design and strategy with a growing strength in AI to help our clients see what is next and achieve bigger outcomes.

At the heart of everything we do is our team. We collaborate, take risks, lift each other up and take pride in doing work the right way, not settling for a quick makeshift solution. If you join Ambush, you join a group of people who want you to succeed and who show up for each other every day.

We believe in and expect real teamwork, a constant drive to be better, and delivering meaningful long term outcomes that we can be proud of together.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Java developer with strong backend fundamentals and hands-on experience building scalable, reactive systems, ideally in payments or fintech environments.

This role focuses on building and maintaining a high-performance, reactive mid-tier service that powers seamless payment experiences for millions of users.


Responsibilities

  • Develop & Maintain: Design, code, and maintain scalable services within a distributed reactive architecture.
  • Debug & Optimize: Troubleshoot production incidents and optimize JVM memory management and application throughput.
  • Testing & Compliance: Ensure code quality through rigorous testing and adhere to strict PCI compliance security standards.
  • Collaborate: Participate in code reviews, technical planning, and daily stand-ups in English.


Technical Qualifications

  • Core Concepts: Strong grasp of OOP, Design Patterns, and SOLID principles.
  • Functional Programming: Proficiency with functional concepts (Lambdas, Streams, Optionals) and reactive programming models.
  • Concurrency: Experience dealing with race conditions, deadlocks, and thread safety in a multi-threaded environment.
  • API Development: Strong experience building and consuming RESTful APIs.

  • Core Concepts: Strong grasp of OOP, Design Patterns, and SOLID principles.
  • Functional Programming: Proficiency with functional concepts (Lambdas, Streams, Optionals) and reactive programming models.
  • Concurrency: Experience dealing with race conditions, deadlocks, and thread safety in a multi-threaded environment.
  • API Development: Strong experience building and consuming RESTful APIs.
